title: How Lara Croft's own choice sank her ship in Tomb Raider
subject: lara
description:
Would you have listened to Whitman? 👇

How Lara Croft's first expedition ended on Yamatai in Tomb Raider (2013). Spoilers for Tomb Raider (2013).

scenes.text: At 21, Lara Croft picked the route that sank her ship.
The Endurance was hunting a lost kingdom. Lara pushed for the Dragon's Triangle, against James Whitman's advice.
A storm split the ship in two and threw her onto Yamatai, once ruled by a sun queen named Himiko.
A cult called the Solarii lived there. Their leader, Mathias, had been stranded for 31 years.
Captain Conrad Roth, her guardian since her father's death, took a tomahawk meant for her.
She burned his body on a pyre, on the island she had insisted on finding.
